title: Every finite cutoff composes the nonlinear Wick Hamiltonian with the closed Gaussian BRST complex

finite_cutoff_composition.carrier: At cutoff N take the residual-invariant reduced Gaussian/Fock factor carrying K1466's Friedrichs operator A_N, tensored with K1429's based-gauge Gaussian boson/ghost factor
finite_cutoff_composition.brst_operator: D_N=1 tensor d_gamma is the same densely defined closed nilpotent Gaussian differential; the interaction is reduced, residual-circle invariant and independent of based-gauge and ghost coordinates
finite_cutoff_composition.hamiltonian: mathbb H_N=A_N tensor 1 + 1 tensor Delta_BRST is the nonnegative self-adjoint operator from the sum of strongly commuting closed forms
finite_cutoff_composition.commutation: Delta_BRST commutes strongly with d_gamma and A_N acts on the other tensor factor, so mathbb H_N preserves Dom(D_N), commutes with D_N on the common core and descends to cohomology
finite_cutoff_composition.cohomology: The positive degree-zero cohomology is the residual-invariant reduced factor tensored with the gauge/ghost vacuum, and the induced interacting Hamiltonian is exactly A_N; higher cohomology remains zero
finite_cutoff_composition.interpretation: This closes finite-cutoff compatibility between the nonlinear Hamiltonian and a closed BRST Hilbert complex without deforming the BRST charge
finite_cutoff_composition.ceiling: The cutoff complex is repository Gaussian gauge fixing, not a source-derived interacting BRST charge. No common continuum form domain, cutoff-stable commutator, interacting BRST limit, Mosco/strong-resolvent limit or GU physical cohomology follows
